flagged.comment: Development site is 2.16 acres (greater than 1-acre threshold) but does not include required closed landfill buffer compliance documentation. Per LDC § 25-1-85, any site greater than 1 acre in size must provide one of the following: (a) professional engineer certification that the site does not overlie a closed municipal solid waste landfill with basis for determination, (b) TCEQ development permit, or (c) professional engineer certification that soil testing will be conducted during foundation construction per TCEQ requirements. No such documentation is provided with the submittal. A landfill buffer certification or equivalent is required prior to site plan approval.

Site area of 2.16 acres exceeds the 1-acre trigger for closed municipal solid waste landfill buffer compliance under LDC § 25-1-85. No PE certification, TCEQ development permit, or PE soil-testing certification has been submitted. One of the three required compliance methods must be provided prior to site plan approval.

Site is 2.16 acres (exceeds the 1-acre trigger under § 25-1-85). No compliance documentation has been provided for the closed municipal solid waste landfill buffer requirement. One of the following three methods must be submitted: (a) PE certification that the site does not overlie a closed landfill with basis for determination; (b) TCEQ development permit; or (c) PE certification that soil testing will be conducted per TCEQ requirements during foundation construction.

Setback compliance cannot be verified. No explicit setback dimension callouts or compliance notes are shown on the site plan (Sheet 9) or grading plan (Sheet 11). While building coverage is documented, zoning setback requirements for MF-2 district per LDC § 25-2-492 are not explicitly verified on site plan. Additionally, Subchapter F compatibility standards (triggered by adjacent SF-3 parcel) require specific height limitations and step-up schedules within 25 feet of the SF-3 lot line, but these are not shown. Provide explicit setback dimension callouts on site plan showing compliance with all applicable zoning setback requirements.

Site plan does not show setback dimensions from property lines to building faces. MF-2 zoning setback compliance must be verified and dimensioned on the site plan, showing distance from property boundary to the nearest building face for all sides of the development.

Cover sheet does not identify applicable Subchapter F Residential Compatibility Standards, which is triggered by the adjacent SF-3 parcel located at 0406100210 (immediate neighbor at west property line). Per the property facts, Subchapter F standards requiring maximum 2 stories / 30 ft height within 25 ft of the SF-3 lot line, step-up schedule, and screening/buffer requirements apply to this site but are not noted on the cover sheet or site plan. All applicable overlays and design guidelines must be identified on the cover sheet with applicable ordinance or code section numbers.

Site plan documentation includes some Subchapter E compliance elements (lighting note for Section 2.5 on Sheet 9; landscaping plan on Sheet 31; pedestrian walkways shown on site plan), but comprehensive documentation of all required Article 2 and Article 3 design standards cannot be verified from available documents. Specific design standards required per applicable street type and development activity (such as building-street relationship, window/glazing requirements, and complete landscaping compliance per all applicable Article 2-3 sections) are not fully documented on the site plan sheets submitted. Either show all required design standard elements on site plan sheets or provide detailed design compliance notes.

Parkland boundaries are not shown on the site plan. Facts documentation confirms that the property is within a Parkland Deficient Area (2 polygon features intersect the parcel), requiring parkland dedication or fee-in-lieu per § 25-1-604(B). Parkland boundary areas must be delineated on the site plan.
areas: parkland deficient area polygon on site
